description: This file defines an enumeration 'ReportRunFrequency' which represents different scheduling frequencies for report runs within the Fineract system. It includes methods to retrieve the enum based on an ID, and to access the properties of each enum constant.

classes.name: ReportRunFrequency
classes.description: An enum representing various report execution frequencies such as daily, weekly, monthly, yearly, and custom. Provides methods for mapping from ID and retrieving properties.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the numerical value associated with the report run frequency.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code representing the report run frequency.

methods.name: fromId
methods.description: Retrieves the ReportRunFrequency enum corresponding to a given ID.
